package domain_test

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func TestNewPersonalTeacherUsesProvidedSettings(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, time.August, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.FixedZone("local", 5*60*60))
	teacher, err := domain.NewPersonalTeacher("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "student-1", domain.DefaultPersonalTeacherSettings(), now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, int64(1), teacher.Version)
	require.Equal(t, "ru", teacher.Language)
	require.Equal(t, now.UTC(), teacher.CreatedAt)
	require.Equal(t, teacher.CreatedAt, teacher.UpdatedAt)
}

func TestNewPersonalTeacherRejectsMissingStudent(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := domain.NewPersonalTeacher("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", " ", domain.DefaultPersonalTeacherSettings(), time.Now())
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestPersonalTeacherUpdateSettingsIsVersioned(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, time.August, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	teacher, err := domain.NewPersonalTeacher("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "student-1", domain.DefaultPersonalTeacherSettings(), now)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	settings := teacher.Settings()
	settings.Language = "EN"
	err = teacher.UpdateSettings(settings, 1, now.Add(time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "en", teacher.Language)
	require.Equal(t, int64(2), teacher.Version)

	err = teacher.UpdateSettings(settings, 1, now.Add(2*time.Minute))
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrVersionConflict)
}
